page.layout: One printed block only: a library ownership stamp in the centre of the page, enclosed in a rectangular frame. All other marks on the page are handwriting (a shelf mark at top left and the manuscript inscription "Pro Bibliotheca Parthenica" in the upper half), which is not transcribed.
page.notes: The page is a blank leaf bearing only a library stamp, handwriting and stains. The printed stamp reads "BIBLIOTHECÆ / Collegii Alumnorum / turicensis." This is a library stamp and is therefore not transcribed as text. The handwritten shelf mark "IV O 370" at top left and the manuscript inscription "Pro Bibliotheca Parthenica." are handwriting, and show-through and ink spots are likewise omitted.
